items.t: Cathie Wood and 8 Other Big Funds Bought Airbnb Last Quarter. Ken Fisher and 11 Others Sold. Who’s Right?
items.sum: Key TakeawaysOf the 460 big funds that have filed 13Fs for the third quarter, nine bought Airbnb, including Cathie Wood’s ARK Invest, and 12 sold, including Ken Fisher’s Fisher Investments. The sellers moved far more money, but two of the three biggest still own large Airbnb stakes, and Fisher sold only 1,600 shares.
